ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 80% high-intensity white/off-white pixels in central regions and 20% low-intensity black pixels localized to the perimeter and internal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the bulk of both lobes; low-intensity black contiguous banding follows the trailing edge and lateral tips; yellowish-tan pixel staining is distributed across central-to-lower visible regions; localized black vertical streaks and circular spots are present on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the black perimeter with pixel-amplitude variations between 2 and 10 pixels; peaks are more jagged and frequent on the inner half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a convex curvature tapering to sharp, pointed tips, while the trailing edge follows a non-linear concave path toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of small, circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme right tip of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical low-intensity linear marks on the left lobe: one prominent streak in the upper-mid section and a shorter parallel mark closer to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization on the right tip; extensive yellowish pixel discoloration (diatom film) across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique teardrop-shaped black pigment spot located in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.
